introduction.imageAltAr: A busy seaport filled with containers and gantry cranes on the Red Sea coast
introduction.title: An integrated platform connecting ports with industry and moving trade on the Red Sea coast
introduction.lead: A specialised business platform bringing the entire transport & logistics ecosystem under one roof.
paragraphs: The supply chain, transport and logistics sector is one of the key enablers of economic and industrial growth, and a central pillar in strengthening the Kingdom's competitiveness and supporting Saudi Vision 2030 — building an advanced logistics system that efficiently and reliably connects ports, industrial zones, distribution centres and local and regional markets.

Building on Yanbu's strategic position as an industrial, economic and logistics hub on the Red Sea coast, the Exhibition brings together an integrated ecosystem of companies specialised in transport, logistics, supply chain, ports, handling, storage, distribution and the associated technologies and solutions.

The Exhibition and its accompanying Conference provide a specialised business platform that brings together decision-makers, investors, operators, service providers, manufacturers, suppliers and end-users — helping to build new partnerships, showcase the latest solutions, and open commercial and investment channels that support the growth of the transport and logistics sector in the Kingdom.

whyExhibit.title: Five reasons participation pays back directly

items.title: Showcasing Your Leadership and Innovative Solutions
items.description: The exhibition is a powerful platform for strengthening your company's brand awareness and showcasing your latest logistics services and solutions in land and maritime transport to a specialized audience seeking excellence.

items.title: Keeping Up with Market and Competitor Trends
items.description: A valuable opportunity to gain firsthand insights into logistics sector trends, discover the latest technologies and innovations, and monitor competitor activity to ensure your company remains at the forefront.

items.title: Expanding Your Customer Network (Networking)
items.description: An ideal opportunity to gain direct access to a wide range of potential customers and target companies, build lasting business relationships, and drive sales growth.

items.title: Entering New Markets
items.description: Whether you are seeking to expand locally or regionally, the exhibition provides the ideal gateway to understand the requirements of new markets and connect with international agents and distributors.

experience.lead: The Exhibition is accompanied by an integrated programme of specialised activities and side events that enhance the commercial value and awareness of the event, including:

items.description: Keynotes and panel discussions on the future of transport, logistics and supply chain, and the role of ports and land transport in supporting economy and industry.

items.title: Decision-Makers Roundtables
items.description: Specialized meetings bringing together executives and sector leaders to discuss challenges, opportunities and practical solutions.

items.title: Specialized Workshops
items.description: Hands-on workshops on fleet management, warehouse efficiency, digital transformation, logistics security, risk management, cold chain and more.

items.title: B2B Business Meetings
items.description: Direct meetings between exhibitors, buyers, factories, companies and investors — converting participation into opportunities and commercial partnerships.

items.title: Innovation & Solutions Zone
items.description: A dedicated space showcasing modern technologies and innovations in AI, automation, IoT and digital solutions.

items.title: Equipment & Handling Live Zone
items.description: A live, hands-on display of equipment and solutions used in warehouses, ports, distribution centres and handling operations.

items.title: Investor & Finance Day
items.description: Sessions connecting investors, banks and finance firms with companies and projects operating in transport and logistics.

items.title: Startup Platform
items.description: A space for startups to present their ideas and solutions to investors, large corporates and potential customers.

items.title: Open Sessions & Live Demos
items.description: Live presentations of new products, technologies and solutions to visitors and specialists.

items.title: Networking Receptions
items.description: Dedicated events fostering connections between exhibitors, visitors, decision-makers and investors — building long-term business relationships.
